name: Numakura Seiji
source:
Protagonist of the story. When he was young, his father committed suicide after being framed by the others and his mother also died from exhaustion of raising him alone. Therefore, he is very sensitive about false accusation.

As if fate played cruel trick on him, he lost everything after receiving a jail sentence due to false accusation of molester from a young lawyer when he was trying to help a high school girl from the real molester on bus.

While watching TV in jail, he gets furious when seeing the hateful couple got married to each other and is enjoying their life full of happiness after ruining his life. When he swears to take revenge, his conman jail mate teaches him about the special aroma which can hypnotize people.

After getting his long-awaited freedom again, he takes advantage of his new trick to change his outward appearance, obtain fame and money in order to realize his goal of vengeance.
